WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yakhiwe hikwalaho ka ntirho wa misava hinkwayo
WatchHomePromo.title: Mahungu a ma cincangi. Ndlela leyi vanhu va langutaka ha yona yi cincile.
WatchHomePromo.description: Hi tlhela hi aka xitolo xa hina xa tivhidiyo ni switirhisiwa hi ku sungula kusuka ebaseni, hi nyiketela ntirho wa ku hundzuluxela wa malembe yo tala eka tipulatifomo leti vanhu va already hlengeletanaka, langutaka, naswona avelanaka eka tona.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Layiburari ya tifilimi leyi hundzuluxeriweke ngopfu emisaveni hinkwayo
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Malembe yo tala ya ntirho wa ku hundzuluxela, leswi rhwaleriweke hi vatirhisani va vurhumiwa lava tshembekaka, swi ake layiburari leyi nga na timalaka ta tindzimi leswaku vanhu va kota ku hlangana na mhaka ya Yesu hi ririmi leri va ri fikelelaka swinene.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Ku rhwala marito lama tshembekaka eka tifomati letintshwa
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Hi tlhela hi aka ndlela leyi tindzaba ta evhangeli ti vulavuriwaka hi yona hi xifaniso, hi hlanganisa swihundzuluxo leswi tshembekaka ni tifomati ta manguva lawa leswaku mahungu ma kota ku famba hi ntshunxeko eka tipulatifomo, mindhavuko ni swikirini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ku tlula layiburari. I ntlawa lowu fambisiwaka hi ntirho.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project i ntlawa wa misava hinkwayo wa vahundzuluxi, vatirhi va swihangalasamahungu, vahleleri, ni vavumbi lava cincelaka malembe yo tala ya ntokoto wa ntirho wa Xikwembu eka switirhisiwa swa vanhu hinkwavo lava endlaka vadyondzisiwa.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Laha hi yi akaka hi yona leyi landzelaka
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Hlanganisa vanhlaleri na mintirho leyi vonakalaka eka ndlela ya vona ya moya, leswi va pfunaka ku teka xitandzhaku xa nkoka eka vuxaka, Matsalwa, kumbe vurhumiwa.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Layiburari ya Vuhaxi bya ku Evhangelisa
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Layiburari leyikulu ya vuhaxi bya Vukreste leyi nga na timiliyoni ta tivhidiyo, tifilimi, ni switirhisiwa leswi kumekaka hi tindzimi to tala ku pfuna ntirho na ku evhangelisa emisaveni hinkwayo.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Nongonoko wa vhidiyo, ku hangalasa swilo, ku hlanganisa vayingiseri, ni analytics leswi endleriweke ku pfuna minisitiri ku fikelela vanhu vo tala hi ndlela leyi tirhaka swinene.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Pfunani ku aka <highlight>xixaka lexi landzelaka</highlight> xa switirhisiwa swa vurhumiwa
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Hi rhamba vaendli, vavumbi, na vatirhisani eka ku kuma ku nghena ka le ka ha ri emahlweni. Ringetani switirhisiwa leswintshwa ku sungula, nyikani mavonelo, naswona pfunani ku vumba switirhisiwa leswi endleriweke ntirho wa ntiyiso wa vurhumiwa.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Languta muqoqo wa hina wa tivhidiyo ni switirhisiwa leswi tisaka Bibele evuton’wini hi tindzaba ni dyondzo leti khangekeke.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Nghena eka ndlela ya hina ya Advent hi vhidiyo ya siku na siku leyi aka ku langutela Khisimusi, yi lavisisa ntshembo, ku tsaka, ni xitshembiso xa ku ta ka Yesu.
